reviews.text: Friendly and courteous service when picking up medication. Excellent location.

An experienced veterinarian is all you need for your dog!

Unfortunately, we're no longer in Barcelona, ​​and I always miss the team at this veterinary clinic. They were impeccable from the start with my poodle, Coco—the whole team was professional and friendly. I've even called them when I'm unsure about other vets (they set the bar very high!), and they still treat me with such kindness and professionalism. I chose them because of a surgery that went perfectly, and I wasn't wrong. 100% recommended! I wish there were more vets like them.
Veterinarians with many years of experience, highly professional and with extensive expertise; I've been going to them for years. Highly recommended.
A very good person, he's super professional.
Very happy with the treatment received and the professionalism. My dog ​​and I recommend it 200%

My friends, both licensed veterinarians practicing since 1981, and completely trustworthy, saved my dog ​​from potential medical negligence at another veterinary clinic, @vetpro. I highly recommend them.

We've been going to these vets for eight years, and the truth is, the treatment they've always given us and our dog has been exceptional. They often offer recommendations, diets, or advice without trying to inflate the bill or oversell us. Their experience is evident; they reassure you if you have any doubts. They always treat our dog wonderfully. They're definitely our go-to vet!
Excellent

My experience has been wonderful! They are both great professionals. In our case, Dr. Florit always takes care of us, and I only have words of gratitude for his kind treatment, both a few years ago with Bimba and now with Lola!

Excellent service. All the family dogs have always been to their clinic and have always received the best care, both from Dr. Florit and Dr. Casas.
Without a doubt, my trusted veterinarian.

I know both veterinarians; they are very experienced in the field. Thanks to them, I can still enjoy the company of my faithful friend, as they saved her life when she had a uterine infection, and "other" veterinarians only said it was a urinary tract infection. I found them thanks to a neighbor, and I will be eternally grateful.
They've always treated us very well, the service is very friendly and it's not outrageously expensive!
